text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
This is the power of energy drinks!
A triumph for science!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
However, your eyes tell me you think it was a coincidence.
Indeed, the results of a single trial
fall well within the margin of error.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I understand what you're trying to say.
In other words—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—You want to experiment more? Wonderful!
Racing games, fighting games, medal games—
pick whichever you like!
